release: Code of the experiments of the QEL paper: QEL (p = 4, 6), eight DFL baselines (OpenPTO) and two SDDR baselines on BA, KP and BM, hidden widths 8 and 12, seed pairs (2025, 1020) ... (2029, 1024).

vendored_code.changes: 34 of the 41 files are unchanged copies of upstream and 7 are edited; UPSTREAM.json in that directory lists every file with its sha256 and describes every edit. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md names the origins of the code.

data.datasets: configs/data_sha256.json: sha256 of the X/y/weights files written by data.regenerate (15 datasets, 35 files)
data.split_inputs: configs/split_inputs_sha256.json: sha256 of the TRAIN/VALID files and of the TEST files written by data.split_inputs

derived_file.data/bm/precomputed/cora_cites_metis.txt: 135-way partition of the Cora citation graph, computed once on macOS (arm64) with METIS 5.1.0 through PyMetis 2025.2.2 (nparts=135, seed 2026); nodes numbered in order of first appearance in cora.cites (NetworkX 3.6), adjacency lists sorted; line i is the part of node i

sddr.reference: Zhang, Liu and Zhao, Operations Research Letters 68:107486, 2026
sddr.use: baselines/sddr*.py is an implementation written for this repository; no source code of that repository is included. The margin 0.3 and the inverse-temperature schedule follow its main_constr_basic.py.
